We have our first quiz this Friday, January 30. The quiz will have 3 or 4 problems, two of which will look like one of the following.

1. Find an equation of the plane containing the three points $(1, 0, -1)$, $(1, 1, 0)$, and $(2, -1, 3)$.
2. Write down a componentwise proof that the dot product of two-dimensional vectors is a commutative operation - i.e.,
  $$
  \vec{u}\cdot\vec{v} = \vec{v}\cdot\vec{u},
  $$
  for all 2D vectors $\vec{u}$ and $\vec{v}$.
